text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer developed argument with multiple paragraphs","quality":"development","description":"This captures how fully an essay elaborates its ideas with explanation and expansion rather than brief assertion."},{"evidence":"uses abstract terms like \"character,\" \"traits,\" \"honesty,\" and \"trust\"","quality":"idea complexity","description":"This captures the ability to discuss more abstract and nuanced concepts instead of staying at a simple personal example level."},{"evidence":"more organized paragraphing with an introduction, body, and conclusion","quality":"overall organization","description":"This captures clearer structural control in presenting and wrapping up an argument."},{"evidence":"connectors such as \"although,\" \"even though,\" and \"therefore\"-style reasoning","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures stronger linking of ideas across sentences and paragraphs."},{"evidence":"attempts to address a counterargument in the last paragraph","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"This captures the ability to acknowledge another view and respond to it within the essay."},{"evidence":"more varied sentence patterns, including complex sentences","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures greater command of sentence structure beyond repeated short, simple statements."}]}
